evidence: Running the repro in the fresh venv reaches triton/runtime/jit.py line 755 and raises TypeError: object of type 'int' has no len(). The saved logs show the kernel reached the fake compile step before the failure.
steps: Run ./setup_env.sh to create .venv and install triton==3.7.1.
Run ./run_repro.sh or ./.venv/bin/python repro.py from the bug folder.
Observe the TypeError raised at len(grid) in triton/runtime/jit.py.
